children: US oncology drug developer's Q3 net loss and loss per share both missed analyst expectations
Higher R&D expenses drove increased losses in Q3, mainly from clinical costs and added personnel
Company expects cash runway to fund operations into Q4 2028 after expanding clinical programs
Immuneering expects updated Phase 2 pancreatic cancer data in 1H 2027
Company says Phase 3 MAPKeeper 301 enrollment is ahead of schedule; topline data now expected mid-2028
Immuneering expects its cash runway to fund operations into Q4 2028
R&D SPENDING - Higher research and development expenses, mainly from increased clinical costs and added personnel, drove increased losses in Q3
CLINICAL PROGRAM EXPANSION - Expansion and acceleration of clinical trials, including extended Phase 2 follow-up and increased Phase 3 enrollment, contributed to higher operating costs
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 7 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the biotechnology & medical research peer group is "buy"
